description: Which Texas business is this? Turns a brand, trade name or legal name into ranked candidates with entity_id, legal name, trade names, an address, confidence (0-1) and match_reasons. Texas only; businesses registered with the Texas Comptroller or TABC, refreshed nightly from Texas state datasets. status is match, possible, ambiguous (add a city or address) or not_found; weak guesses are never returned. Example: {"name": "Heim Barbecue", "city": "Fort Worth"}. Pass the entity_id to the other tools.

address.description: Street address, e.g. "1109 W Magnolia Ave".

city.description: Texas city, e.g. "Fort Worth". Strongly improves ranking.

name.description: Business, brand or legal name, e.g. "Heim Barbecue".

name: resolve_business
title: Identify a Texas business
